title: React Internals & Fiber Architecture
description: Understand React's virtual DOM, reconciliation algorithm, Fiber architecture, and how React updates the DOM efficiently.

data.text: React uses a virtual DOM to minimize actual DOM manipulations. The reconciliation algorithm determines the minimal set of changes needed to update the UI.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Virtual DOM is an in-memory representation of the actual DOM
Reconciliation compares virtual DOM trees to find minimal changes
Fiber architecture enables incremental rendering and prioritization
Understanding internals helps with performance optimization
data.takeaway: React's virtual DOM and Fiber architecture enable efficient UI updates. Understanding these internals helps debug performance issues and write more optimized React code.
